title: Normalized scalar counit on the coefficient module
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $T$ with $\ell$ invertible, normalized Chern data $c$ [def-sp-tower-class-chern], and an ordinary coefficient arrow $e:c.scalar.model.E(coefficient(T,R_T))\to coefficient(T,A_T)$ whose ordinary scalar-adjunction transpose is $scalarGenerator_T$ [def-sp-tower-class-coefficients]. Then the component of $scalarSingleCounit(c)$ followed by the single of $e$ equals $c.scalarUnit.hom$.

source.place: Paragraph (2): integral reduction to (Z/ell^(n+1))_n, followed by extension to (O_E/ell^(n+1))_n; agent expansion of geometric naturality in realization steps 1--5.

proof.text: The coefficient single is K-flat by the cochain tensor right unitor. Apply ScalarData.transpose_model to the induced chain map and use the single-complex adjunction calculation to identify its ordinary transpose with scalarGenerator. The normalized Chern hypothesis supplies the same transpose for scalarUnit. Cancel the exact restriction single comparison and use injectivity of the derived Hom equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarCounitNormalization {T : Scheme.{u}} (c : Chern l E T)
    (nc : c.Normalized l E)
    (e : c.scalar.model.E.obj (coefficient T (Rrings l T)) ⟶
      coefficient T (Arings l E T))
    (he : (c.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.homEquiv _ _) e = scalarGenerator l E T) :
    (scalarSingleCounit c).app (coefficient T (Rrings l T)) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems T (Arings l E T)) 0).map e =
      c.scalarUnit.hom
